title: Algebraic reconstruction from orbit data
statement: Let H and C be commutative rings with an H-algebra structure, G a group acting on C by H-algebra homomorphisms ρ, and d a natural number. Let α : G →* Equiv.Perm (Fin d), and let D be FixedOrbitData G d with D.action = α. Then the H-algebra of equivariant functions on Fin d is isomorphic to the product over orbit representatives k : Fin D.m of the intersections of equalizers of ρ ζ and the identity, over ζ in the stabilizer of k.

proof.text: Construct the equivariant algebra isomorphism by evaluation on orbit representatives and extension along the finite group action.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03SF (finite Galois covers), 023R (fpqc descent of quasi-coherent sheaves), 0245 (affine morphisms descend); injective localization in a domain
